ig_caption:
Thu, Nov 12: 1,380 deer reported statewide (1,045 antlered, 335 antlerless). Season total: 98,373.

Kent's 32 new reports on Thursday were 94% antlered, the highest share of any county with 25 or more, against 76% statewide. Shiawassee added 35 and moved from eighth to sixth in the season rankings, passing Tuscola and Lapeer.
